إثباتُ الميزان وصفتُه عند علماء المالكية من خلال النصوص الشرعية

Authors

  • عبدالله علي عبدالله فتح الله كلية التربية,جامعة مصراته المؤلف

DOI:

https://doi.org/10.64516/delalat.v17i1.437

Keywords:

Balance, its characteristics, Maliki scholars, Islamic legal texts

Abstract

This study aims to demonstrate the care and concern of Maliki scholars regarding matters of Islamic creed, including the issue of proving the Balance and explaining its attributes as clarified by the legal texts of the Book of God and the Sunnah of His Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, and that it is a truth that must be believed in regarding the events of the Day of Resurrection. It used the descriptive and analytical method and divided it into an introduction, two sections, and a conclusion. The introduction included the importance of the research, the reasons for choosing it, the methodology followed in the study, and the research plan. The first section dealt with the concept of the Balance linguistically and legally, its description, and the evidence for its existence. The second section dealt with the statements of early and later Maliki scholars regarding the existence of the Balance and its attributes mentioned in the texts. The conclusion included the most important results and recommendations that it reached.
